blocks.text: 138-darsda **out** ning yo'nalish ma'nosini (go out, move out, check out) va «chetda qoldirish» ma'nosini (leave out, drop out) ko'rdik. Qizil kitobda esa run out of, find out, work out, turn out kabi fe'llar tanishtirilgan (→ qizil kitob, 121-dars). Bu darsda **out** ning yana to'rt muhim ma'nosini guruhlab o'rganamiz: **1)** o'chish, yo'qolish; **2)** butunlay, oxirigacha; **3)** aniqlash, tushunish; **4)** bajarish, tarqatish, yuzaga chiqish. O'zbekchada ularga ko'pincha «o'chib qolmoq», «tugab qolmoq», «sotilib bitmoq», «bilib olmoq», «aniqlab chiqmoq» kabi ko'makchi fe'llar to'g'ri keladi.

Olov, chiroq yoki sham yonmay qolsa — **out**. Muhim juftlik: **go out** — o'zi o'chmoq (to'ldiruvchisiz), **put out** — kimdir o'chiradi (to'ldiruvchili). Bu xuddi o'zbekchadagi «o'chmoq — o'chirmoq» farqi: The fire **went out** — Olov **o'chdi**; They **put** the fire **out** — Olovni **o'chirishdi**. Kengroq ma'noda **out** — butunlay yo'qolish: **die out** (tur, an'ana, til yo'qolib ketmoq), **wipe out** (qirib yubormoq), **stamp out** (barham bermoq).

items.text: The candle **went out**, so Aziz lit it again with a match.
items.translation: Sham **o'chib qoldi**, Aziz uni gugurt bilan qayta yoqdi.

items.text: Two neighbours helped to **put out** the fire before the firefighters arrived.
items.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar kelguncha ikki qo'shni yong'inni **o'chirishga** yordam berdi.

items.text: Some languages **die out** when their last speakers pass away.
items.translation: Ba'zi tillar so'nggi so'zlashuvchilari vafot etgach **yo'qolib ketadi**.

blocks.text: Bu guruhda **out** biror narsa **to'liq tugashini** bildiradi: **run out** (tugab qolmoq), **sell out** (sotilib bitmoq), **wear out** (yeyilib ketmoq; **be worn out** — holdan toymoq), **clear out** (bo'shatib tozalamoq). Nozik joy — ega: narsa o'zi tugasa — **run out** (Our money **ran out**), odamda narsa tugasa — **run out of** (We **ran out of** money). **run out** hujjat muddati haqida ham ishlatiladi: My visa **runs out** in May.

rows: The shop has **sold out of** bread.
I've **worn out** my shoes. / I'm **worn out**.

items.text: We **ran out of** coffee halfway through the night shift.
Patience is **running out** — people have been waiting for three hours.
items.translation: Sabr **tugayapti** — odamlar uch soatdan beri kutishyapti.

items.text: The concert in Edinburgh was **sold out** weeks ago.
items.translation: Edinburgdagi konsert chiptalari bir necha hafta oldin **sotilib bo'lgan**.

blocks.text: Yashirin narsa «tashqariga», ko'rinadigan joyga chiqadi. Bu fe'llar o'zbeklarda ko'p chalkashadi, chunki hammasi «bilmoq / tushunmoq» ga yaqin. Farq — **qanday** bilinadi: **find out** — tashqi manbadan (so'rab, o'qib, eshitib); **work out** / **figure out** — o'z boshing bilan o'ylab yoki hisoblab; **make out** — ko'z yoki quloq bilan, qiyinchilik bilan; **point out** — boshqaning e'tiborini qaratib; **turn out** — voqealar natijasida, ko'pincha kutilmaganda. Esda tuting: **know** — holat (bilaman), **find out** — bilib qolish lahzasi (bilib qoldim).

rows: ko'z yoki quloq bilan, qiyinchilik bilan

items.text: I didn't know Kate was married — I only **found out** last week.
items.translation: Keytning turmushga chiqqanini bilmasdim — faqat o'tgan hafta **bilib qoldim**.

items.text: Can you **work out** how long the journey will take?
items.translation: Yo'l qancha vaqt olishini **hisoblab chiqa olasanmi**?

items.text: The famous expert **turned out to be** a student with no real experience.
items.translation: Mashhur mutaxassis haqiqiy tajribasi yo'q talaba **bo'lib chiqdi**.

blocks.text: **turn out** uch qolipda keladi: **turn out + sifat / ravish** (The party **turned out** well), **turn out to be / to have** (She **turned out to be** a great boss), **it turned out that ...** (It **turned out that** he was lying). **As it turned out** — «keyin ma'lum bo'lishicha». **work out** esa uchinchi ma'noda «yaxshi natija bermoq» ni bildiradi: I hope things **work out** for you.

Rejani, buyruqni yoki tadqiqotni «tashqariga», hayotga chiqarish — **carry out** (amalga oshirmoq, o'tkazmoq; rasmiyroq). Yangi narsani amalda sinash — **try out**. Muammoni hal qilish — **sort out**. Ko'p odamga berish — **hand out** / **give out**. Birdaniga yuzaga chiqish — **break out** (urush, yong'in, kasallik), **come out** (kitob, film chiqmoq; sir oshkor bo'lmoq). Boshqalardan ajralib, ko'zga tashlanish — **stand out**. Imkoniyatni «tashqariga chiqarib tashlash» — **rule out** (istisno qilmoq).

items.text: The hospital **carried out** more than two hundred operations last month.
items.translation: O'tgan oy kasalxonada ikki yuzdan ortiq operatsiya **o'tkazildi**.

items.text: We'll **carry on** with the project, but the tests will be **carried out** next month.
items.translation: Loyihani **davom ettiramiz**, lekin sinovlar kelasi oy **o'tkaziladi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: **carry out** (bajarmoq) va **carry on** (davom etmoq) ni chalkashtirish — «Carry out, please, I'm listening» → **Carry on**, please; «I knew about it yesterday» → I **found out** about it yesterday (bilib qolish — find out, bilish holati — know); «We are run out of milk» → We **have run out of** milk / We**'re out of** milk; «run out milk» → **run out of** milk; o'zbekcha «o'chirmoq» ni bitta fe'l bilan tarjima qilish — olov va sigaret: **put out**, sham: **blow out**, chiroq va televizor: **turn off** / **switch off**; «The fire was put off» → The fire was **put out** (put off — keyinga qoldirmoq, → 140-dars).

Gapda **out** ni ko'rsangiz, to'rt savoldan birini bering: biror narsa **o'chdimi / yo'qoldimi** (go out, die out)? **Tugadimi** (run out, sell out)? **Aniqlandimi** (find out, work out, turn out)? **Bajarildimi / yuzaga chiqdimi** (carry out, break out)? O'zbekcha qolip ham shunga mos: o'chib qoldi — tugab qoldi — bilib qoldi — o'tkazildi.
Bog'lanish: out ning yo'nalish va «chetda qoldirish» ma'nolari — 138-dars; **carry on**, **go on** (davom etmoq) — 141-dars; **put off**, **call off** — 140-dars; frazali fe'l turlari — 137-dars.

examples.title: Not burning any more: **go out**, **put out**, **die out**
examples.description: **out** — o'chish va yo'qolish: **go out** (o'zi o'chmoq) ↔ **put out** (o'chirmoq: olov, sigaret); **blow out** — puflab o'chirmoq; **die out** — yo'qolib ketmoq; **wipe out** — qirib yubormoq; **stamp out** — barham bermoq.

sentences.text: The campfire **went out** during the night, and we woke up freezing.
sentences.translation: Gulxan kechasi **o'chib qolibdi**, biz sovuqdan qotib uyg'ondik.

sentences.text: It took the firefighters three hours to **put out** the fire at the factory.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilarga zavoddagi yong'inni **o'chirish** uchun uch soat kerak bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Make a wish and **blow out** the candles before the wax drips on the cake!
sentences.translation: Niyat qil-u, sham mumi tortga tommasdan ularni **puflab o'chir**!

sentences.text: Please **put** your cigarette **out** — smoking isn't allowed on the platform.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, sigaretingizni **o'chiring** — platformada chekish mumkin emas.

sentences.text: During the storm the street lights **went out** one after another.
sentences.translation: Bo'ron paytida ko'cha chiroqlari birin-ketin **o'chib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Many old crafts in Khiva almost **died out**, but young masters are bringing them back.
sentences.translation: Xivadagi ko'plab qadimiy hunarlar deyarli **yo'qolib ketgan edi**, lekin yosh ustalar ularni qayta tiklashyapti.

sentences.text: Scientists believe that a huge asteroid **wiped out** the dinosaurs.
sentences.translation: Olimlarning fikricha, dinozavrlarni ulkan asteroid **qirib yuborgan**.

sentences.text: Is this tradition **dying out**, or do young people still follow it?
sentences.translation: Bu an'ana **yo'qolib ketyaptimi** yoki yoshlar hali ham unga amal qilishadimi?

sentences.text: The government promised to **stamp out** corruption in the police force.
sentences.translation: Hukumat politsiyadagi korrupsiyaga **barham berishga** va'da berdi.

sentences.text: Don't let the stove **go out**, or the flat will be cold by the morning.
sentences.translation: Pechka **o'chib qolmasin**, aks holda ertalabgacha kvartira sovib ketadi.

examples.title: Finishing: **run out**, **sell out**, **wear out**
examples.description: **out** — butunlay, oxirigacha: **run out (of)** — tugab qolmoq, muddati tugamoq; **sell out (of)** — sotilib bitmoq; **wear out** — eskirtirmoq, **be worn out** — holdan toymoq; **tire out** — charchatib qo'ymoq; **clear out** — bo'shatib tozalamoq.

sentences.text: We're **running out of** printer paper — can you order some more?
sentences.translation: Printer qog'ozimiz **tugab qolyapti** — yana buyurtma bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: Hurry up — time is **running out**, and the shop closes in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Tezroq — vaqt **tugayapti**, do'kon o'n daqiqadan keyin yopiladi.

sentences.text: My passport **runs out** in March, so I need to renew it before the trip.
sentences.translation: Pasportimning **muddati martda tugaydi**, shuning uchun safardan oldin uni yangilashim kerak.

sentences.text: The tickets for the final **sold out** within an hour of going on sale.
sentences.translation: Final chiptalari sotuvga chiqqanidan keyin bir soat ichida **sotilib bitdi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, we've **sold out of** the chocolate cake, but there's some cheesecake left.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, shokoladli tort **tugab qoldi**, lekin chizkeyk bor.

sentences.text: I walk so much that I **wear out** a pair of shoes every six months.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik ko'p yuramanki, har olti oyda bir juft poyabzalni **eskirtirib tashlayman**.

sentences.text: After twelve hours on the ward, Nilufar was completely **worn out**.
sentences.translation: Bo'limdagi o'n ikki soatlik smenadan keyin Nilufar butunlay **holdan toygan edi**.

sentences.text: This weekend we're going to **clear out** the garage and get rid of the junk.
sentences.translation: Shu dam olish kunlari garajni **bo'shatib tozalab**, keraksiz narsalardan qutulamiz.

sentences.text: The children **tired** themselves **out** running around the park all afternoon.
sentences.translation: Bolalar tushdan keyin bo'yi bog'da yugurib, **charchab holdan toyishdi**.

sentences.text: What will happen when the world's oil finally **runs out**?
sentences.translation: Dunyodagi neft oxiri **tugab qolsa**, nima bo'ladi?

examples.title: Finding and understanding: **find out**, **work out**
examples.description: **find out** — (so'rab, o'qib) bilib olmoq; **work out** / **figure out** — o'ylab, hisoblab topmoq, tushunib olmoq; **suss out** (BrE, so'zlashuv) — sezib qolmoq. **know** — holat, **find out** — bilib qolish lahzasi.

sentences.text: I only **found out** about the meeting when my colleague sent me a message.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish haqida faqat hamkasbim xabar yuborganda **bilib qoldim**.

sentences.text: Could you **find out** whether there's a direct train from London to Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: Londondan Edinburgga to'g'ri poyezd bor-yo'qligini **bilib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: How did your parents **find out** that you'd failed the exam?
sentences.translation: Imtihondan yiqilganingni ota-onang qanday **bilib qolishdi**?

sentences.text: Let's **work out** how much each of us owes for the dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat uchun har birimiz qancha to'lashimiz kerakligini **hisoblab chiqaylik**.

sentences.text: Bekzod spent an hour trying to **figure out** why the app kept crashing.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ilova nega qayta-qayta ishdan chiqayotganini **tushunib olishga** bir soat urindi.

sentences.text: The detective quickly **worked out** who had taken the money.
sentences.translation: Tergovchi pulni kim olganini tezda **aniqlab oldi**.

sentences.text: I can't **figure** him **out** — one day he's friendly, the next he ignores me.
sentences.translation: Uni **tushunolmayman** — bir kun xushmuomala, ertasiga meni ko'rmaganga oladi.

sentences.text: Have you **worked out** the answer to question five yet?
sentences.translation: Beshinchi savolning javobini **topdingmi**?

sentences.text: Did you ever **find out** who sent you those flowers?
sentences.translation: O'sha gullarni kim yuborganini oxiri **bilib oldingmi**?

sentences.text: Emma soon **sussed out** that her new flatmate was lying about her job.
sentences.translation: Emma yangi xonadoshi ishi haqida yolg'on gapirayotganini tezda **sezib qoldi**.

examples.title: Noticing: **make out**, **point out**, **stand out**
examples.description: **make out** — (zo'rg'a) ko'rmoq, eshitmoq, o'qimoq; **point out** — e'tiborni qaratmoq, ta'kidlamoq; **stand out** — ko'zga tashlanmoq; **check out** — borib ko'rmoq, tekshirmoq; **look out for** — ko'z-quloq bo'lmoq, qidirmoq.

sentences.text: The sign was so far away that I couldn't **make out** what it said.
sentences.translation: Yozuv shunchalik uzoqda ediki, nima yozilganini **ajrata olmadim**.

sentences.text: In the fog we could just **make out** the shape of a lorry ahead.
sentences.translation: Tumanda oldimizdagi yuk mashinasining qorasini zo'rg'a **ilg'ay oldik**.

sentences.text: Can you **make out** what she's saying? The music is too loud.
sentences.translation: Uning nima deyayotganini **eshita olyapsanmi**? Musiqa juda baland.

sentences.text: My supervisor **pointed out** a few mistakes in the second chapter of my thesis.
sentences.translation: Ilmiy rahbarim dissertatsiyamning ikkinchi bobidagi bir nechta xatoni **ko'rsatib o'tdi**.

sentences.text: As Sarah **pointed out**, the plan will cost much more than we expected.
sentences.translation: Sara **ta'kidlaganidek**, reja biz kutganimizdan ancha qimmatga tushadi.

sentences.text: With her bright red coat, Madina really **stood out** in the crowd.
sentences.translation: Yorqin qizil paltosi bilan Madina olomon orasida rosa **ko'zga tashlanib turardi**.

sentences.text: What makes your CV **stand out** from hundreds of others?
sentences.translation: Rezyumeingizni yuzlab boshqalaridan nima **ajratib turadi**?

sentences.text: You should **check out** the new exhibition at the Tate — it's brilliant.
sentences.translation: Teyt galereyasidagi yangi ko'rgazmani **borib ko'rishing** kerak — ajoyib.

sentences.text: When you're in Samarkand, **look out for** the small bakeries near the bazaar.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga borganingizda, bozor yaqinidagi kichik novvoyxonalarni **qidirib ko'ring**.

sentences.text: Before we signed, a lawyer **pointed out** that the contract had no end date.
sentences.translation: Biz imzolashdan oldin advokat shartnomada tugash sanasi yo'qligini **ta'kidlab o'tdi**.

examples.title: Unexpected results: **turn out**, **work out**
examples.description: **turn out** — oxir-oqibat ... bo'lib chiqmoq, ma'lum bo'lmoq: turn out + sifat / to be / that ...; **as it turned out** — keyin ma'lum bo'lishicha; **work out** — (ish, reja) o'zini oqlamoq; **pan out** — natijalanmoq.

sentences.text: We expected rain, but the day **turned out** sunny and warm.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir kutgan edik, lekin kun quyoshli va iliq **bo'lib chiqdi**.

sentences.text: The quiet new student **turned out to be** a brilliant chess player.
sentences.translation: Indamas yangi talaba ajoyib shaxmatchi **bo'lib chiqdi**.

sentences.text: It **turned out** that the restaurant had closed years ago.
sentences.translation: Restoran allaqachon yillar oldin yopilgani **ma'lum bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: As it **turned out**, we didn't need the umbrellas after all.
sentences.translation: Keyin **ma'lum bo'lishicha**, bizga soyabonlar umuman kerak emas ekan.

sentences.text: How did the interview go? — It **turned out** better than I'd hoped.
sentences.translation: Suhbat qanday o'tdi? — Umid qilganimdan ham yaxshiroq **bo'lib chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry — I'm sure everything will **work out** in the end.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang — oxir-oqibat hammasi **joyiga tushib ketishiga** ishonaman.

sentences.text: Their marriage didn't **work out**, but they're still good friends.
sentences.translation: Ularning turmushi **yurishmadi**, lekin hali ham yaxshi do'st.

sentences.text: Moving to Manchester **worked out** well for Oliver: he found a great job.
sentences.translation: Manchesterga ko'chish Oliver uchun **o'zini oqladi**: u zo'r ish topdi.

sentences.text: If the new schedule doesn't **work out**, we'll go back to the old one.
sentences.translation: Yangi jadval **o'zini oqlamasa**, eskisiga qaytamiz.

sentences.text: Nobody knows yet how the negotiations will **pan out**.
sentences.translation: Muzokaralar qanday **natija berishini** hali hech kim bilmaydi.

examples.title: Doing the job: **carry out**, **try out**, **sort out**
examples.description: **carry out** — amalga oshirmoq, bajarmoq (reja, tadqiqot, ta'mir, ko'rsatma); **try out** — sinab ko'rmoq; **sort out** — hal qilmoq, tartibga solmoq; **hand out** / **give out** — tarqatmoq; **set out to** — maqsad qilib qo'ymoq.

sentences.text: The workers will **carry out** repairs on the bridge over the weekend.
sentences.translation: Ishchilar dam olish kunlari ko'prikda ta'mirlash ishlarini **olib boradi**.

sentences.text: Nurses must **carry out** the doctor's instructions exactly.
sentences.translation: Hamshiralar shifokor ko'rsatmalarini aynan **bajarishi** shart.

sentences.text: A team in Oxford **carried out** tests on the new vaccine.
sentences.translation: Oksforddagi jamoa yangi vaksina ustida sinovlar **o'tkazdi**.

sentences.text: Can I **try** the bike **out** before I pay for it?
sentences.translation: Velosipedni pulini to'lashdan oldin **sinab ko'rsam** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Our school is **trying out** a new timetable this term.
sentences.translation: Maktabimiz bu chorakda yangi dars jadvalini **sinab ko'ryapti**.

sentences.text: There's a problem with your visa, but the embassy will **sort** it **out**.
sentences.translation: Vizangizda muammo bor, lekin elchixona uni **hal qiladi**.

sentences.text: I need a whole day to **sort out** all the papers on my desk.
sentences.translation: Stolimdagi barcha qog'ozlarni **tartibga solish** uchun menga butun bir kun kerak.

sentences.text: The teacher **handed out** the exam papers and told us to start.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi imtihon varaqalarini **tarqatdi** va boshlashimizni aytdi.

sentences.text: Volunteers were **giving out** free water to the runners.
sentences.translation: Ko'ngillilar yuguruvchilarga bepul suv **tarqatishayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **set out to** build the biggest online bookshop in Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Jasur O'zbekistondagi eng katta onlayn kitob do'konini qurishni **maqsad qilib qo'ydi**.

examples.title: In the news: **break out**, **speak out**, **rule out**
examples.description: **break out** — (urush, yong'in, kasallik) boshlanib ketmoq; **speak out** — ochiq qarshi chiqmoq; **rule out** — istisno qilmoq, chetlatmoq; **give out** — ishdan chiqmoq; **fall out with** — arazlashib qolmoq; **come out** — chiqmoq, oshkor bo'lmoq.

sentences.text: When the war **broke out**, my great-grandfather was only seventeen.
sentences.translation: Urush **boshlanganda** katta bobom endigina o'n yetti yoshda edi.

sentences.text: A flu epidemic **broke out** in the school, and it closed for a week.
sentences.translation: Maktabda gripp epidemiyasi **tarqaldi** va u bir haftaga yopildi.

sentences.text: Several doctors **spoke out** against the plan to close the children's hospital.
sentences.translation: Bir nechta shifokor bolalar kasalxonasini yopish rejasiga qarshi **ochiq chiqdi**.

sentences.text: The police haven't **ruled out** the possibility that the fire was started deliberately.
sentences.translation: Politsiya yong'in ataylab qo'yilgan bo'lishi ehtimolini **istisno qilmadi**.

sentences.text: Because of his knee injury, Tom has been **ruled out** of Saturday's match.
sentences.translation: Tizzasidagi jarohat tufayli Tom shanbadagi o'yindan **chetlatildi**.

sentences.text: After twenty kilometres, my legs finally **gave out** and I had to stop.
sentences.translation: Yigirma kilometrdan keyin oyoqlarim oxiri **yurolmay qoldi** va to'xtashga majbur bo'ldim.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **fell out with** her sister over their grandmother's house.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza buvisining uyi tufayli singlisi bilan **arazlashib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Her second novel **comes out** next month, and the critics are already excited.
sentences.translation: Uning ikkinchi romani kelasi oy **chiqadi**, tanqidchilar allaqachon hayajonda.

sentences.text: Eventually the truth **came out**: the manager had known about the problem for months.
sentences.translation: Oxiri haqiqat **oshkor bo'ldi**: menejer muammo haqida oylar davomida bilgan ekan.

sentences.text: Fighting **broke out** between rival fans after the match in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi o'yindan keyin raqib muxlislar o'rtasida mushtlashuv **boshlanib ketdi**.

examples.title: Mixed: a camping trip that went wrong
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: bitta hikoyada **out** ning to'rt ma'nosi — o'chish, tugash, aniqlash va bajarish.

sentences.text: We **set out** from Tashkent early on Saturday, full of energy and plans.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni erta tongda Toshkentdan g'ayratga to'lib **yo'lga chiqdik**.

sentences.text: By the time we reached the mountains, we had **run out of** petrol and had to walk.
sentences.translation: Tog'larga yetganimizda benzinimiz **tugab qolgan edi**, piyoda yurishga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: It **turned out** that Jasur had forgotten the tent poles at home.
sentences.translation: Jasur chodir tayoqlarini uyda unutib qoldirgani **ma'lum bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Madina **worked out** a clever way to hang the tent between two trees.
sentences.translation: Madina chodirni ikki daraxt orasiga osishning aqlli yo'lini **o'ylab topdi**.

sentences.text: In the evening the wind kept **putting out** our campfire.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun shamol gulxanimizni qayta-qayta **o'chirib qo'yaverdi**.

sentences.text: Then Bekzod **pointed out** that we had camped right next to a wasps' nest.
sentences.translation: Keyin Bekzod ari uyasining shundoq yonida chodir tikkanimizga **e'tiborimizni qaratdi**.

sentences.text: During the night the batteries in our torches **ran out**, so we sat in the dark.
sentences.translation: Kechasi fonarlarimizdagi batareyalar **tugab qoldi**, shuning uchun qorong'ida o'tirdik.

sentences.text: We could just **make out** the lights of a village far below us.
sentences.translation: Pastda, olisda bir qishloqning chiroqlarini zo'rg'a **ilg'adik**.

sentences.text: In the morning we were **worn out**, hungry and very cold.
sentences.translation: Ertalab **holdan toygan**, och va qattiq sovqotgan edik.

sentences.text: Still, the trip **worked out** fine in the end, and we're already planning the next one.
sentences.translation: Shunday bo'lsa ham, safar oxir-oqibat yaxshi **yakunlandi**, keyingisini allaqachon rejalashtiryapmiz.
